SECTION B: Very Short Answer Type Questions (2 Marks Each)

Q21. Why did the Simon Commission come to India? Why was it boycotted?

Answer / Solution:
Why did the Simon Commission come to India? Why was it boycotted? 
Reason for arrival: To look into the functioning of the constitutional system in India 
and suggest changes. 
Reason for boycott: It did not have a single Indian member; it was an “all-white” 
commission.
